class_reason: All six Table 1 targets (four PSPM coefficients and two vertex counts) reproduce to the paper's rounding, and each coefficient's interval from the pre-registered reduced bootstrap (authors' seeds 1..3, estimate +/- 1.96 SD) excludes 0 (batch4 class decision 3 gives A; alternative class if only the full 120-draw bootstrap counts: E).
confidence_reason: Point estimates and counts match by script; all 6 reproduced bootstrap draws equal the deposited draws for the same seeds within 3.6e-7; environment drift (igraph 2.1.4, reticulate 1.41, Python 3.12, aarch64) did not change any value at 2 decimals.
uncertainties: Significance rests on K = 3 bootstrap draws per model (pre-registered rule K = min(10, floor(25/t)), t = 6.6 min for the first draw); the printed 120-draw percentile intervals were not recomputed. The reproduced draws equal the deposited draws for seeds 1-3 (outputs/compare_boot_vs_deposited.csv), so the deposited 120-draw intervals are consistent with this run, but draws 4-120 were not re-run.
